episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication to prevent lost deals and explores the role of AI in enhancing real estate processes. He emphasizes that while AI can solve for experience, it cannot replace the human touch and emotional intelligence that agents provide. The conversation offers actionable insights for agents and team leaders to improve client management and leverage technology effectively.
